title: Skydive Spaceland Florida
specs: Located near Lake Okeechobee with scenic views
One of the longest-running skydiving centers in Florida with strong safety record
USPA membership card/license required for experienced jumpers
In-date reserve card and seal required for own gear
Licensed and current required to rent gear or under direct supervision of instructor
Free organizer slot for groups with at least 20 paying slots for events
Events require registration fee with nonrefundable administrative fee of at least $20 per person

includes: Pack job included with gear rental
blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from 14,000 feet with trained instructors. The center also offers a Skydiver Training Program to get licensed, gear rental, and supports experienced skydivers with jump tickets and facilities. The drop zone operates Thursdays through Mondays and welcomes spectators.
extraNote: Prepay at least 24 hours ahead for discounted tandem rates · Military, police, fire dept., EMS, healthcare rate $179 anytime · No night jumps or high pulls on rental gear · Airglades Airport drop zone, south of Lake Okeechobee

quotes.text: Gino was f*****g awesome from beginning to end. He made me feel comfortable, kept the energy fun, and gave clear instructions throughout the entire experience. I was surprisingly calm going into my first jump, and I genuinely think Gino played a huge part in that. He made everything feel natural and effortless, and I couldn't have asked for a better instructor for my first skydive. Already looking forward to T2!

quotes.author: Chad Bryan
quotes.text: This place is top notch!! My son obtained his class A certification and both my wife did some tandem jumps with him. The staff are amazing especially Gabe and Sarah…all the others were amazing but my adrenaline has made me forget names. Safety is their priority and I am coming back to get certified soon..highly recommended if you want to experience a rush like no other

quotes.author: Logan
quotes.text: What an amazing experience! Clint was an amazing instructor and made my first jump a breeze. Chris did great with the videography! Can’t wait for my next jump. Everyone is so nice and friendly!

quotes.author: Alva Eng
quotes.text: Fantastic experience! Jimmy was wonderful and did a great job of joking around and helping me feel less nervous. He made the whole experience so much fun! Highly recommend!
